M1_guard_off_by_one.description: guard `>= N` mistakenly written as `>= N-1` (fires one cycle too early)

M2_wrong_transition_target.description: transition `A -> B` written as `A -> C` (wrong target state)

M3_unreachable_target.description: guard threshold set far too high (`>= 99999`), target state never reached

M4_missing_forced_transition.description: forced transition `! ...` line missing (global event ignored)

M6_wrong_effect_value.description: effect assigns wrong constant (`var = N` → `var = N+100`)

evidence: NL requires states `increase`, `hold`, and `decrease`; DSL defines exactly these three leaf states.
NL: increase sets `k1=1, k2=0, n=0`; DSL enter action for `increase` assigns those values.
NL: hold sets `k1=0, k2=0, n=0`; DSL enter action for `hold` assigns those values.
NL: decrease sets `k1=0, k2=1, n=500`; DSL enter action for `decrease` assigns those values.
NL transition guards are `slp <= 0.01`, `slp > 0.01`, `slp < -0.01`, and `slp >= -0.01`; DSL implements those guards on the corresponding transitions.
findings.summary: The DSL closely matches the stated three-state ABS hydraulic supervisor, including state names, valve/pump outputs, and all four slip-error threshold guards.
